About Civil Engineering
Civil engineering is considered one of the core branches of engineering and is also oldest branch of engineering. Study of civil engineering includes study of all the basic facilities/services related to civilians. About Civil Engineering Department
The department of civil engineering was established in year 1988 with an intake capacity of 30 students. The intake capacity was then increased to 60 in the year 2007 & subsequently increased to 120 in year 2011. The department is equipped with total 10 labs with an investment of Rs. 1,36,93,135.86 which are used for various academics, research and consultancy works.

Faculty
The department has well qualified faculties, some with doctorate qualification. They continuously tilted and engaged to impart quality education to students. Consultancy
The consultancy cell is actively providing services related to building material testing, structure design reviews, non – destructive testing, surveying, soil Investigation etc. The client list includes various government organization, government and private contractors, builders etc.
Students
The students of department are actively participating and winning awards in competitions (projects computer/ paper presentations /sports) apart from achieving academic excellence. The department has large alumni network with graduate students working at various large private institutes with good ranks. They have also succeeded in competitive exams related to civil engineering. HOD'S MESSAGE
The Civil Engineering Department at KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur, is one of the oldest, focusing on aligning its curriculum with industry needs.
Benefited by faculty with rich experience of academics and focused on practical knowledge transfer by involving students in consultancy activities.
The department promotes holistic development with state of art classrooms and laboratories and encourages students to grow through co-curricular activities along with academics.
